title: Jason And Lucia's Apartment Was A Real Building
sources: Kotaku: GTA 6 Lucia and Jason apartment, Miami / Vice City real location
Dexerto: GTA 6 fan tracks down Jason and Lucias real-life apartment years after it was demolished
Player.One: GTA 6 fans claim they found Jason and Lucias Vice City apartment in real life
GameNGuide (30 Aug 2026): fans may have found the real Miami apartment (demolition date varies between sources, so not stated; Rockstar has not confirmed)

lines.text: Jason and Lucia's apartment may be a real Miami building. And fans say it's already gone.
A fan started with the skyline you see through the apartment window.
They matched a tall teal tower in that view to real Miami landmarks.
That pointed to a condo called the Belmar, near Biscayne Bay.
But on today's maps, the lot looked completely empty.
So the fan dug through old Street View photos, and the building showed up.
Reports disagree on when it was torn down, and Rockstar has not confirmed any of this.
So did Rockstar copy a building that no longer exists?
